newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Union Paper moves into property sector.
newsitem.headline: Union Paper moves into property sector.

text.p: Malaysia's Union Paper Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday it was venturing into property development with the acquisition of three companies.

In a statement, Union Paper said it has proposed to acquire all of Sempurna Cekap Sdn Bhd and Metroway Sdn Bhd for a total of 170 million ringgit. The purchases are to be funded by the issue of 42.5 million new Union Paper shares at 4.00 ringgit per share, it said.
Union Paper also plans to acquire a 51 percent stake in I.C.B. Sdn Bhd for 1.0 million ringgit in cash.
Sempurna Cekap owns 64.06 acres of vacant land in central Selangor state which has been approved for development into commercial and industrial properties.
Metroway is a property developer while I.C.B. is involved in construction and civil engineering.
Union Paper said it has also proposed to sell its wholly-owned subsidiary, Union Paper Industries Sdn Bhd for 7.0 million ringgit cash.

It said the company's core business of manufacturing recycling paper and trading of paper products has been incurring losses due mainly to increased competition. "The proposals represent a restructuring exercise undertaken to rescue the company through injection of income generating assets and the disposal of loss-making businesses," it said.
Union Paper's paid-up capital will increase to 59.86 million ringgit from 17.36 million after the acquisitions.
The company has requested lifting of its stock suspension. The shares of Union Paper have been suspended since February 19 and were last traded at 17.80 ringgit.
